news.title: Pick your art style
news.body: Five art styles to choose from in Esc, Settings, Art style: Bright Anime, Painted Meadow, Crisp Cel, Twilight Festival and Moonlit Night. The game saves and reloads in the new look.

news.title: A whole new world
news.body: Emberfall Vale is reborn in a cel-shaded anime style and the world is three times bigger: five zones, five towns and Wind Riders to fly between them. Make up to 8 characters on the new character select screen. Every class now learns 8 skills, and talent trees open at level 10. Find gear in 13 slots and 6 rarities, check it on your new character sheet, and take on 41 quests, elites and five zone bosses. Press Esc for the game menu.

news.title: The launcher is here
news.body: Emberfall Vale now has its own Windows launcher. It checks for new versions every time you open it, so you get new content without reinstalling. Pick windowed or fullscreen, a resolution and a graphics level in Settings.

news.title: Heroes of the Vale
news.body: Create your own hero. Choose Elf, Dwarf, Fishfolk or Undead, male or female, and your skin, hair and style. Then pick a class: the shapeshifting Druid, the Rogue, the Archer or the Warlock.

news.title: Emberfall Vale opens
news.body: Explore an open valley of meadows, forests, lakes and mountains. Help Elder Maren with four quests, level up, and face the Ember Golem in the ruins to the northeast.
